snippet.title: Galaxy on Fire 2 Full HD by FISHLABS - Official Trailer (HD)
snippet.description: Finally, after investing five man-years extra development time, Galaxy on Fire 2™ Full HD is available on the Mac™ App Store and will set your Mac on fire. Enjoy the most popular sci-fi game on iPhone and iPad, with an average user rating of 4.8 stars and tons of top industry gaming awards, at super crisp 1080p resolution on your Mac Mini, iMac, Mac Pro, MacBook, MacBook Air or MacBook Pro. Enter your spaceship now: http://bit.ly/gof2hd-mac
